headline: Longwood topple High Point and Gardner-Webb on the road
dek: Longwood won at Winthrop, at High Point and at Gardner-Webb across ten days in November, scoring nine and conceding two. High Point had lost to no conference side until then, Gardner-Webb to one. Wake Forest ended the run five days later.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring does not sort this table. Longwood have scored as many as anyone and conceded 39, more than Gardner-Webb or High Point, the two sides above everyone in the table.

wire.line: Longwood's season outlasted the rest: they beat the table's top two away before losing at Wake Forest.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches from August still carry no result, among them Gardner-Webb's home match with Wofford and Longwood's visit to Virginia.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Presbyterian have not won a match all season: one draw and fifteen defeats.
